You are building a billed-run screening harness (offline until a human confirms) in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/screen.py (new) and tests/test_environment_screen.py (new). Never edit storygame/, packages/, data/, docs/, worker/, bench/frozen/, or any other file (import from scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py and scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py, do not change them). You never make a live call: only `--dry` and hermetic tests run.

READ FIRST: .plans/grounded-llm-environment-narration.md ('Experiment and adoption gates' item 1-3 is the design; the T3b/T3c/T3e/T4a records), scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py (state hashing, case capture, the bypass_for_capture technique, package hash), scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (CallCounter, QuotaExceeded, _narration_from_reply, _body_from_http_error, _quota_code, _stub_jev, _stub_item_facts, _boarding_ask, _state_at, the transport and its --confirm/--max-calls gating) and scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/open_probe.py (CLI shape, partial rows), tests/test_observation_prompt.py (how to set provider.observation_request and capture the narrator request, and how to copy the real package to tmp_path and declare `view` / `contents_complete` as in tests/test_package_view_scope.py), storygame/runtime/observation.py, worker/src/models.js and worker/src/index.js (the X-Bench-Model header, model ids, prices, max token ceilings).

BUILD scripts/ringer/environment_narration/screen.py. THE SCREEN: six frozen starts on package data/stories/continuity-initiative, each with TWO contexts, E 'existing' (provider.observation_request None: exactly what the current code would send, using the bypass_for_capture technique for consumed turns) and P 'proposed' (observation_request set). Starts: S1 boarding ('Enter the truck.' from outside_house, kind enter, focus the truck); S2 outside view ('Look through the truck window.' from outside_house, kind look, focus the truck; P runs on a tmp copy of the package whose truck declares `view` from the outside area with no blocker; E on the shipped package); S3 moved item ('Examine my laptop.' after the laptop was moved to the protagonist, kind look, focus the laptop); S4 drawer opening ('Open the drawer.' in the house room that holds the drawer, kind open, focus the drawer; a control where P should add no invented content); S5 searched scope after recovery ('Search beneath the drawer.' after the memory card was recovered into the protagonist's hands, kind look, focus the drawer; P runs on a tmp copy declaring the drawer contents_complete; E on the shipped package); S6 unrelated nearby observation ('Look around.' in the kitchen, kind look, focus the kitchen area). Discover real place/entity ids from the package; assert the world facts each start relies on (fail loudly). Tmp package copies are created and deleted by the harness; record the shipped and the copy package hash per start. The system text must be identical between E and P within a start (fail loudly if not).
MODELS (exactly these three ids, sent through the Worker header `X-Bench-Model`): @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast (baseline; max_tokens 1024), @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast (max_tokens 1024), @cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (max_tokens 3072, reasoning allowance). Prices per million tokens input/output: 0.282/0.827, 0.293/2.253, 0.30/1.20 (read them from worker/src/budget.js text if simple, else constants with a comment citing it). A cell = start x context x model: 36 cells.
CLI: (1) `--dry --out PATH`: writes JSON holding, per start and context, the exact system and user text, state hash, package hashes, request kind/focus, expected observations (required names and the things that must NOT appear: for S5 a re-found card or any replacement clue, for S2/S1 a driving or exit), a unified diff E vs P of the user text, and a `cost` object: input tokens estimated as ceil(utf8 bytes of system+user / 3) (the Worker's estimator) per prompt, the per-cell ceiling USD at max_tokens, and `ceiling_usd` for a given `--samples N` (default 10) plus `--smoke` (6 calls: S1 x both contexts x 3 models, one sample each) listed separately; deterministic byte-identical output, zero network, prints a short table (cells, calls, ceiling USD). (2) `--smoke --confirm` and `--run --samples N --confirm --max-calls K --max-usd U`: refuse without --confirm, without CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL, if calls exceed K (default 366), or if the estimated ceiling exceeds U (required for --run; refuse if missing); send each call as `POST {url}` with JSON {system, user, max_tokens, response_format: {type: json_object}}, headers Authorization Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN (when set), User-Agent as boarding_probe, and `X-Bench-Model: <model>`; interleave round-robin over the 36 cells sample by sample (no cell is finished before another starts); NO retries and NO replacement samples; write the full rows file after EVERY call (partial rows survive); each row records start, context, model, sample index, requested model, the model the Worker echoed (STOP the run immediately and mark it invalid if they differ), HTTP status, raw response, raw reply, parsed narration (or unusable), the Worker's `truncated` flag if present, response headers X-Worker-Revision, latency ms, and request byte sizes; stop at once on a 429 whose body contains AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and record the stop reason; also stop on BENCH_MODEL_REJECTED (the Worker is not configured for the benchmark). (3) `--report --rows PATH --out PATH.md`: render markdown that shows EVERY call (successes and failures), grouped by start then context then model, with the full narration text, usable/unusable, status, latency, plus per start the required and forbidden items as a blank hand-scoring checklist, and a summary table of counts (usable, unusable, errors, truncated) and observed token cost if usage was returned. Do NOT score quality automatically.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_environment_screen.py (hermetic; socket and urllib patched to fail unless a fake opener is injected; no worker; no model): (a) the dry document has 6 starts x 2 contexts, 36 cells, byte-identical across two runs, system identical between E and P, and the stated differences hold (S1 P user text contains `Show these in your reply: Kristin's laptop` and E contains `Just before this:`; S2 P lists the laptop in THINGS and E does not; S3 P/E show the laptop held by Kristin; S5 P contains `holds nothing else the player can find` and E does not; S6 P adds nothing about the truck); (b) the cost block: calls = cells x samples, ceiling_usd > 0 and equals the sum of per-call ceilings, and a --max-usd below it refuses with no call; (c) live path refuses without --confirm, without CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL, over --max-calls, and missing --max-usd; (d) with a fake opener: sends X-Bench-Model, interleaves cells, writes partial rows after each call, stops with no more calls on an AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED 429 and on BENCH_MODEL_REJECTED, marks the run invalid and stops when the echoed model differs, never retries a failed call; (e) --report renders all rows including a failure row. Run them, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; run `--dry` and report the table.
